deployment: This changes workflow and review policy code and needs a fresh independent human GitHub approval of the final source head plus complete platform qualification. After verified immutable Root publication, component workflow pins/policy opt-ins must adopt that same trusted source before claiming this behavior across all three repositories. Existing branch protection and paid_ai=false remain in force.

included_security_fix.result: Verified immutable publication and exact reviewed source/native qualification.

actual_resolver_replay.limits: Local resolver produced the exact human-reviewed and qualified module bytes; this replay does not create or approve a GitHub PR.

python_tests.skip_reason: Existing tests require native host facilities.

events: Ready PR opened, reopened, synchronized or made ready after a draft.
Independent admission finds a manual change or blocked CI.
Automatic approval fails and needs attention.
notifications.idempotency: Pending requests and current-head completed human reviews are respected; a changed head can request a fresh review.
notifications.no_pr_or_self_review: Blocked proposal/freshness issues are assigned to the owner; an owner-authored PR is assigned because GitHub prohibits self-review.
notifications.permissions: Unprivileged PR signal has no checkout or write permission. Trusted protected-main notification code uses Contents read, Pull requests write and Issues write, with no App keys, release write or signing authority.

human_controls: New module or package paths, dependency role changes, major or prerelease migrations.
Compiler support-branch changes, native source, installation hooks or scripts.
Workflow, approval and security-control source changes.
policy.legacy_behavior: Policies without the new opt-in retain patch-only behavior until reviewed rollout.
scope: Existing Go and npm dependencies within the same stable major version, rooted in authenticated security advisories.
Only Go versions required by the minimum advisory fixes and their independently resolved, checksum-verified constraints.
Official Node security releases within an already supported LTS major.

preceding_candidate.publication: The candidate merged but its Discovery v0.1.3 selection was never published in a platform. This follow-up supersedes that selection with the verified fixed v0.1.4 and retains RPA v0.1.6.

reason: The owner requested that a minor dependency version change should not by itself require human approval once its verified security-fix inputs and complete CI pass, and that every change requiring human action sends a native GitHub review request or assigned attention issue.
